FASHION & BEAUTY

Hairdressing and African hairstyling.

Braids, cornrows, weaves, locs, cuts and hair care.

The trade at a glance.

A hairdresser does cuts, braids, cornrows, weaves, relaxing and hair treatments. African hairstyling — braids, locs, protective styles — is a sought-after skill, across the continent and in the diaspora.

MAIN ACTIVITIES

Hairdressing in a salon
Home and event services
Fitting wigs and weaves
Advice and sale of hair products

Objectives of the programme.

01

Assess the scalp and hair type

02

Create braids, cornrows, weaves and locs

03

Carry out treatments, relaxing and colouring safely

04

Welcome, advise and retain customers

Skills acquired

  • Hygiene and hair diagnosis
  • Braids and cornrows
  • Weaves and wigs
  • Men's and women's cuts
  • Treatments, relaxing and colouring
  • Customer service and product sales

Equipment and tools

Styling stationsShampoo basinsHair dryers and hood dryersClippers and scissorsTraining headsProfessional products

Curriculum module by module.

  • Salon and tool hygiene
  • Hair and scalp diagnosis
  • Shampoos and treatments
  • Braids and cornrows
  • Protective styles
  • Creating and maintaining locs
  • Weaves and wig fitting
  • Women's and men's cuts
  • Styling and blow-drying
  • Safe relaxing and colouring
  • Customer service and loyalty
  • Product and stock management
  • Internship in a partner salon
  • Supervised by a mentor
  • Review and job preparation

And after the programme?

Working for a company

Hairdresser in a salonSpecialist braiderHome or event hairdresserSalon manager

Our network of partner companies hosts interns and recruits our learners.

Starting your own business

Many hairdressers start working from home before opening their own salon. The institute helps them build their range of services, manage their product stock and prepare, step by step, to open their own salon.

A vocational training institute based in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir trains young people and adults for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology.
